title: setPauser is a privileged single-write state change but emits no event
rootCause: `setPauser(address)` modifies `pauser` (the address authorized to call `pause`/`unpause`, which override the IPausable interface) but emits no event. The natspec explicitly allows `pauser = address(0)` to disable pausing -- a notable governance signal that should be on-chain observable.
impact: Off-chain monitoring (governance dashboards, security alerting, incident-response tooling) cannot detect a pauser change without trace-replay or full storage diffing. This is exactly the kind of state change Aderyn flagged in ADERYN-006.
steps: owner.setPauser(maliciousAddress) -- only an internal SSTORE; no log.
Security monitor relying on event feeds sees nothing.
Malicious pauser later calls pause() at a critical moment; the prior setPauser call is invisible in standard monitoring.
remediation: Add `event PauserUpdated(address indexed oldPauser, address indexed newPauser);` and emit it inside `setPauser`.
